# foodpack — Shenzhen Food Pack Technology Co., Ltd.

Shenzhen Food Pack Technology Co., Ltd. (brand: foodpack) is a manufacturer and exporter of disposable food packaging, based in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China, with its own factory in Shantou, Guangdong. Founded in 2003. Daily output 60,000 pieces across moulding, printing and assembly.

## Products
Two material lines — food-grade plastic and eco-friendly kraft paper. The moulded and paper ranges are customizable in size, colour, structure and printing.

### Plastic Series
- Sushi Boxes — PS trays with clear OPS lids, single or multi-cavity, FP-00 to FP-11 sizes. https://www.foodpackcn.com/products/sushi-boxes.html
- Lunch Boxes — PS and BOPS bento boxes, single or multi-compartment, leak-resistant lids. https://www.foodpackcn.com/products/lunch-boxes.html
- Soy Sauce Bottles — lightweight PE, 15 ml and 30 ml, white bottle with red / green / black cap (stock moulds only). https://www.foodpackcn.com/products/soy-sauce-bottles.html
- Sauce Cups — one-piece PP, 20 ml / 0.7 oz, lid attached, leak-free; 100 cups per sleeve. https://www.foodpackcn.com/products/sauce-cups.html
- Soup Bowls — PS with clear OPS lids, leak-resistant for takeaway, ramen and hot food delivery. https://www.foodpackcn.com/products/soup-bowls.html

### Eco-Friendly Paper Series
- Kraft Sushi Boxes — grease-resistant kraft with clear PET lids, plastic-reduced. https://www.foodpackcn.com/products/kraft-sushi-boxes.html
- Kraft Lunch Boxes — grease-resistant kraft with clear lids, for salads and grain bowls. https://www.foodpackcn.com/products/kraft-lunch-boxes.html
- Kraft Soup Bowls — kraft paper with lids for ramen, pho and hot soup takeaway. https://www.foodpackcn.com/products/kraft-soup-bowls.html

## Materials & Compliance
Food-grade plastics: PS, OPS, BOPS, PP, PE. The paper series uses grease-resistant kraft paper.
Key products are tested by SGS against US FDA 21 CFR 177.1640 and EU Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 with (EU) No 10/2011 — all reports Pass. LFGB reports for the paper series and heavy-metal screening are available on request.

## Customization
OEM and ODM supported: dimensions, cavity structure, thickness, colour and printing (logo embossed into the tray wall, printed on IML film, or as a private-label sticker). Sampling lead time 3–5 days.

## Company
- Founded: 2003
- Factory: 5,000 m² in Shantou, Guangdong; daily capacity 60,000 pieces
- Office: Room 204, Building 7, Holiday Prime Residence, N28 District, Haibin Community, Xin'an Street, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Export markets: Spain, Belgium, Peru, Canada, Australia, Hong Kong SAR (China), and the Chinese domestic market
- Payment: T/T bank transfer only — 30% deposit, 70% balance before shipment. Quoted FOB Yantian.
